dish.title: French Mushroom Bourguignon over Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes
dish.description: Cremini mushrooms seared in batches and braised with pearl onions, carrots, onion, garlic, tomato paste, and thyme in red wine and vegetable broth thickened with flour and deepened with soy sauce, spooned over Yukon Gold potatoes mashed with olive oil and finished with parsley.

recipe_version.title: French Mushroom Bourguignon over Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes
recipe_version.description: Cremini mushrooms seared in batches and braised with pearl onions, carrots, onion, garlic, tomato paste, and thyme in red wine and vegetable broth thickened with flour and deepened with soy sauce, spooned over Yukon Gold potatoes mashed with olive oil and finished with parsley.

ingredients.name: dry red wine
ingredients.display_name: dry red wine labeled vegan (such as a Pinot Noir or Burgundy)

ingredients.name: vegetable broth
ingredients.display_name: vegetable broth whose label lists vegetables, salt, and spices

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp stew, 1 tsp potato pot, 1/2 tsp mash

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Quarter the mushrooms, chop the onion, cut the carrots into coins, mince the garlic, peel and cut the potatoes into 2-inch chunks, and chop the parsley.

steps.title: Sear the mushrooms
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in the 5.5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high, about 2 minutes. Sear half the mushrooms in one layer, stirring only twice, until deeply browned, about 6 minutes per batch. Move to a bowl and repeat with 1 tbsp more oil (2 batches).

steps.title: Braise
steps.body: Add the last 1 tbsp stew oil, the onion, and carrots and cook 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, and flour for 2 minutes. Pour in the wine, scrape up the browned bits, and simmer 3 minutes. Add the broth, thyme, bay leaf, soy sauce, pearl onions, 1 tsp salt, pepper, and the mushrooms. Bring to a simmer, about 4 minutes, then simmer uncovered, stirring now and then, until glossy and thick, about 25 minutes.

steps.title: Mash the potatoes
steps.body: While the stew simmers (overlap stated): put the potatoes, 8 cups water, and 1 tsp salt in the covered 4-quart pot and bring to a boil over high, about 10 minutes to come to a boil. Simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Scoop out 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid, drain, and mash with 1/4 cup oil, 1/2 tsp salt, and enough of the liquid to make them smooth.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Remove the thyme stems and bay leaf. Spoon the mash into shallow bowls, ladle the bourguignon over, and scatter with parsley.
